tags: 6 Inch Center to Center Ladder Style Handles

text.description_html:
10 Inch Ladder Style Shower Handles

The 10" contemporary Ladder Pull is perfect for glass doors such as shower doors. It is available in polished chrome, brushed nickel, and oil rubbed bronze finishes to fit any decor; but it is the sharp, clean lines of this handle that give it a modern feel. It has a 6" center to center mounting. This glass door handle is made out of 3/4" diameter round tubing. For glass 5/16" to 1/2" thick.

Also Available: Longer 12" Glass Door Ladder Pull

Specifications and Features of the Contemporary Ladder Style Handle:

  • Overall Length: 10" (254 mm)
  • Length: 6" Center to Center (152 mm)
  • Tubing Diameter: 3/4" (19 mm) Round
  • Inner Contact Tubing: 5/6" (16 mm)
  • Overall Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Hole in Glass Diameter: 3/8" Minimum
  • For 5/16" (8 mm) to 1/2" (12 mm) thick glass
  • Back-to-back mounting, for Glass Door

Sold as a pair (2 pulls) for glass door.
